item.title: Supermail 0.2.2387
item.description:
• The inbox comes up first on a big mailbox instead of a long spinner (Mac)
  • Mail filed away during a sync break is saved right after it (Mac and iPhone)
  • The public app is called Postal, with Postal's icon (Mac and iPhone)
  • Ask Claude finds mail the Mac hasn't saved, and search keeps Gmail's results when a few don't load (Mac and iPhone)
  • Ask Gemma finds emails by meaning on the iPhone, under Ask Claude (staff iPhone)
  • Name First and Rider First logos to pick from, wordmark stays the default (staff Mac and iPhone)
  • Ask Gemma finds emails by meaning on the Mac, beside Ask Claude (staff Mac)
  • Suggest Postal Labels reads your mail on this Mac and offers labels to make (staff Mac)
  • Saving in Postal keeps what was changed in Gmail since the editor opened (Mac and iPhone)
  • Claude's answers in a floating box you can drag, and Cmd+Return asks Claude however fast you type (staff Mac)
  • Every label shows on every email row, Super Labels too, except the one you're in (Mac and iPhone)
  • Claude's answers in a sidebar beside the mail, and Left or Right for it and the side panel (Mac)
  • Ask Claude shows on the staff iPhone and iPad before Krinkov is connected, with Connect Krinkov
  • Set the vacation responder from the iPhone (staff), see if it's on (public)
  • The too-big warning clears when a file is removed, and no longer names Gmail on an Outlook account (Mac and iPhone)
  • New mail comes first and a check never throws its work away, however big the backlog (Mac and iPhone)
  • Emails with files up to 25 MB send from Outlook accounts (staff Mac and iPhone)
  • Cmd+Shift+Period takes a Gmail draft away at once (Mac and iPhone)
  • Senders can't see when you open their email (Mac and iPhone)
  • The sidebar's rows stop below the window buttons when it scrolls (Mac)
  • The search box no longer quits when results get shorter (Mac)
  • Cmd+A or a drag no longer grays out the open email (Mac)
  • The Mac refuses files past Gmail's 25 MB in total, as the iPhone does
  • Follow-ups and past questions on the staff iPhone and iPad, and Ask Claude easy to see
  • Show the preview text under the subject, a choice in Settings > Layout (Mac)
  • A Layout page for where things sit in the window (Mac)
  • Finished Goods accounts start with the Finished Goods logo (staff Mac and iPhone)
  • Past questions to Claude in the empty search box and Cmd+K (staff Mac)
  • Undo stays beside words that wrap (Mac and iPhone)
  • Ask Claude follow-ups on its page, and reopen past questions (staff Mac)
